{{Top|leg}}
'''Chubb Squadron''' was a [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|BTL Y-wing starfighter]] [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] in service of the [[Dimok government]]. During the [[Sepan Civil War]], they attempted to [[Raid on the Tropsobor|attack]] an [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] task force led by the [[Victory I-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Victory I''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Protector (Victory I-class)|''Protector'']]. When the [[Ton-Falk-class escort carrier|''Ton-Falk''-class escort carrier]] ''[[Tropsobor]]'' began transferring [[Flight group/Legends|groups]] of [[TIE/ad starfighter]]s to the [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]], they attempted to target them, but were defeated by [[Maarek Stele/Legends|Maarek Stele]] and several other [[TIE pilot]]s.
